correctness.rationale: Shor Proposition 3.4 fully classifies reflective semigroups by admissible multiplicity a with explicit gap layers. For a>=3, only g+ja upper-layer gaps are isolated, including g iff a|(g-1); for a=2, all odd gaps isolated. Thus I(g,a)=floor(g/a)+1_(a|g-1)+(g-1)/2*1_(a=2,g odd). Summing admissible a gives exact integer tail, with at most two exceptional one-unit corrections. Divisor counts provide uniform rate and k=2 lower scale; divisor-sum identity gives mean log g using standard hyperbola estimates. Independently generated actual semigroups and checked every tail for g=2..59.
